officialSummary: The Ministry of Culture successfully organised two major engagement programmes - Shilpkar Samagam (2–3 September 2026) and the Vendor Development Programme (7-8 September 2026) - as part of the ongoing development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum (YYBM)
title: The Ministry of Culture successfully organised two major engagement programmes - Shilpkar Samagam (2–3 September 2026) and the Vendor Development Programme (7-8 September 2026) - as part of the ongoing development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat
